order.title: How to order
order.lead: Every piece is handmade in Kashmir. Tell us what you like and we will help you choose.

steps.choose: Note the code printed on each piece you like.
steps.message: Send the codes to us on WhatsApp. We reply with more photos, colours and the final price.
steps.payUpi: Pay by UPI or cash, and we pack and send your shawls.
steps.pay: Pay as agreed, and we pack and send your shawls.

order.thanks: Thank you for looking through our collection.

message.outro: Reply with the code of any piece you like.
